hypothesis: The reservation step in complete-cart serializes stock checks with the Locking module, whose default in-memory provider keeps locks in a per-process Map. With two servers on one database, carts on server 1 and server 2 completed together should each pass the availability check for the single SOLO unit and both create reservations, giving an oversold SOLO item (no_oversell fails, and possibly reserved_matches_reservations passes since counters are updated consistently).
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: solo-two-servers-race
description: Two carts each want the single SOLO unit and are completed at the same time on two different servers sharing one database.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 2
stock:
  SOLO: 1
carts:
  alice:
    server: 1
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1
  bob:
    server: 2
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1
race:
- id: alice-completes
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: alice
- id: bob-completes
  server: 2
  do: complete
  cart: bob
timing:
  release: together
  jitter_ms:
  - 0
  - 3
faults: []
runs: 20
seed: 7

Each is checked against stock individually, and if the entries for the same inventory item are not summed, a combined overcommit of the 10 shared units could be accepted. Expected: no_oversell fails when orders together need more than 10 WIDGET units.
